# Vishal Rashmika (Vishal Rashmika Perera)

> Software Engineer & Systems Developer based in Colombo, Western Province, Sri Lanka. Also known as Vishal Rashmika Perera and Vishal Perera. Software engineer and systems developer specializing in systems programming, reverse engineering, web applications, developer tooling, and scalable architecture.

## Overview
Vishal Rashmika (full name: Vishal Rashmika Perera, also known as Vishal Perera) is a Software Engineer and Systems Developer based in Colombo, Western Province, Sri Lanka. Specializing in systems programming, reverse engineering, and developer tooling, he serves as Co-Founder & Tech Lead at OlyraLabs, creator of developer tools including Office Suite for Obsidian (5,500+ downloads), Canvas++ (240+ downloads), and agyq, and Year 2 Dean's List honoree at Universal College Lanka (UCL) and the University of Central Lancashire.

## Core Competencies
- **Languages:** C, C++, x86-64 Assembly, Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C# / .NET, SQL, HTML/CSS
- **Systems & Engineering:** Reverse Engineering, Binary Disassembly, Debugging & Symbol Analysis, Linux Internals, CLI Architecture, Network Protocols
- **Web & Frameworks:** Astro (SSG / Islands Architecture), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Node.js, Express, Vite, RESTful APIs
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Linux Administration, Git, Netlify

## Key Projects
- [Office Suite](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/office-suite) [TypeScript, Obsidian, Productivity, WYSIWYG, Open Source] - 5,500+ downloads ([Live Demo](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/office-suite) | [Source Code](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/office-suite)): All-in-one productivity plugin for Obsidian enabling native WYSIWYG viewing and editing of Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), CSV/TSV spreadsheets, and PDF annotations directly inside notes with zero external dependencies.
- [Canvas++](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/canvas-plus-plus) [TypeScript, Obsidian, JSON Canvas, UML, Whiteboard] - 240+ downloads ([Live Demo](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/canvas-plus-plus) | [Source Code](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/canvas-plus-plus)): Extensible, high-performance visual diagramming canvas for Obsidian. Features instant shape auto-detection, natural whiteboard drawing, structured tables, collapsible groups, and full UML 2.x software architecture modeling with JSON Canvas compatibility.
- [agyq](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/agyq) [Go, CLI, Systems, Autonomous Agents, Automation] ([Live Demo](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/agyq) | [Source Code](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/agyq)): Sequential, crash-safe prompt queue runner and headless daemon for the Antigravity CLI (agy), engineered with Git checkpoint recovery, quota rate-limit auto-pausing, deferred failure retries, and zero external dependencies.
- [LangDetect.Net](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LangDetect.Net) [.NET, C#, NLP, Algorithms] - 280+ downloads ([Live Demo](https://www.nuget.org/packages/LangDetect.Net) | [Source Code](https://github.com/VishalRashmika/LangDetect.Net)): A lightweight, self-contained .NET package for text-based language detection supporting 12 languages. Uses three algorithmic strategies to improve accuracy and has 280+ NuGet downloads.
- [WyrdLang](https://vishalrashmika.com) [Compilers, C++, Java, Systems]: A custom programming language with fantasy-inspired keywords. Built with a custom-made interpreter in C++ and paired with WyrdPad, a lightweight IDE written in Java.
- [SinSo API](https://sinso-portal.vishalrashmika.com) [REST API, Backend, Node.js, Open Source] ([Live Demo](https://sinso-portal.vishalrashmika.com)): The largest open source Sinhala lyrics API, offering access to 10,000+ song lyrics through a RESTful API with a community submission portal.
- [Blossom Theme](https://blossomtheme.github.io/) [UI/UX Design, Themes, Blender, Styling] - 2,300+ downloads ([Live Demo](https://blossomtheme.github.io/)): A software color theme inspired by Japan’s vibrant urban aesthetics. Co-founded the organization and contributed to multiple variants.
- [PopQuest](https://popquest.github.io/) [Web App, JavaScript, Frontend, Interactive] ([Live Demo](https://popquest.github.io/)): An interactive web application built as a polished, playful public experience.
- [Life Via Lens](https://vishalrashmika.com) [Photography, Media, Visual Storytelling, Arts]: A photography and visual storytelling project focused on framing everyday moments with a cinematic eye.
- [Nyxia](https://vishalrashmika.com) [Mobile App, Flutter, Dart, Astrophotography]: An astrophotography planning app for better nights under the stars. Built in Flutter with weather insights, celestial tracking, calculators, and event management.
- [Rejuvenation Clinic](https://rejuvenationclinic.lk) [Web, Healthcare, Client Solution, UI Design] ([Live Demo](https://rejuvenationclinic.lk)): Medical clinic website for Rejuvenation Clinic, built as a clean public-facing brand and service presence.
